notes.title: Endless Mode Update
notes.content:
Procedural Levels
Completing the base levels now unlocks Endless Mode! This mode allows you to generate a set of 30 levels that roughly increase in difficulty. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047622/d562478672bafce1ac91774af0d4251574558952.gif

You can re-generate levels any time you like, such as when you've completed the current set or are stuck on a level and want a fresh start.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047622/8a108b73d0f974c556aa324c31815c93c1267b52.gif

As a bonus Endless Mode includes some new level grids not seen in the base levels! There's also a new Steam achievement for completing a set of Endless levels.

Other Updates
UI visibility
For those prefer a more relaxing experience you may enjoy the new Hide UI button. You can now get rid of the clutter in the top UI and focus purely on the gameplay itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047622/d8f22204ebdf0bc49d79f99c78d7a0ad99a84a27.gif

Active level indicator
The level select screen now highlights which level you just came from.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047622/c15bfbcbb4ac3f2c70cfb18edbd385b01cc14a4c.png

Previous/next level shortcuts
Clearing a set of levels, whether it's the base levels or a set of endless levels, now unlocks next and previous level shortcuts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047622/84821952501f774c2ae97c9cbbe3fb9337d29b4e.gif

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: V1.01
notes.content:
Added an exit button to the game with an on-hover tooltip that lets players know the game will save on exit. The game already auto-saved even on a force close (ie. alt+f4) but I added this explicit button so first-time players aren't confused about whether or not the game will save if they exit
 Fixed a bug with the level select button not being clickable when it first unlocks and requiring a game restart to become clickable
